PC Errata 2013 disc card of [[Chief Retwin]]: A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 5 May 2013. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy. Source: Players Committee card image [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/CloudCity-Dark/large/chiefretwin.gif chiefretwin.gif] in the starwarsccg.org card lists. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130505010120/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/CloudCity-Dark/large/chiefretwin.gif Internet Archive] (5 May 2013, the earliest archived copy); the same file was still served on 15 July 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260715014325/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/CloudCity-Dark/large/chiefretwin.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Chief Retwin (PC Errata 2013 disc card)]].
